meta.name: She Knows Everything
meta.description:
Mysterious cases take place at an apartment complex which is about to go under reconstruction. Lee Goong-Bok is a real estate agent that works with apartments there. She has a meddlesome type of personality. In Cheol-Ho is a veteran detective.

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8

videos.title: Miss Lee Tries to Hide Something
videos.overview: A temporary high school teacher’s dead body is found in the garden in front of her apartment. However, people are more worried about its effect on their apartment prices than the deceased. Miss Lee, who is responsible for almost all affairs related to this very apartment’s reconstruction, is questioned by a police officer, Ho Chul, who feels something awkward about the death.

videos.title: Ho Chul Feels Something Is Missing
videos.overview: After questioning witnesses that surround the death of a high school teacher, Yang Su Jin, Ho Chul still feels that there is a missing piece of the story. As he digs into the case, he realizes that there is a complicated tie among those who knew Su Jin. Meanwhile, weird cases break out around the neighborhood, which all seem to be connected one way or another.

videos.title: Yang Su Jin’s Case Turns into a Murder Case
videos.overview: With the autopsy showing death from suffocation, Yang Su Jin's case turns into a murder case. Two suspects are on the list, Seo Tae Hwa and Im Jung Kwon. However, the police don't have any hard evidence to arrest anyone. Meanwhile, Goong Bok gets Tae Hwa out from police custody for attacking Lee Myung Won.

videos.title: Hold On Tight
videos.overview: The police find evidence that Tae Hwa was at Su Jin's house at the time of her death and go after him. Meanwhile, Tae Hwa goes after Lee Myung Won and gets in a fight with him. Handcuffed in the back of Ho Chul's car and headed back to the precinct, Tae Hwa gets a sudden call from Goong Bok, telling him to grab on to something tight.

videos.title: Brotherhood
videos.overview: Miss Lee fills in Tae Hwa on why Su Jin had a relationship with Lee Myung Won. And after seeing and hearing Myung Won and Ho Chul's conversation on a home CCTV recording no one knew about, they now know that Myung Won and Ho Chul are related. Later, Miss Lee uses the home security recording to set things straight with Ho Chul.

videos.title: DNA Results
videos.overview: Miss Lee and Ho Chul scramble to find Su Jin's phone, hoping to be the first one to find any evidence. However, Nam Ki Soon, an old lady with dementia, makes it a difficult task. Meanwhile. Ho Chul gets a call regarding the DNA results found underneath Yang Su Jin's nails.

videos.title: The Confession
videos.overview: Bong Man Rae admits to killing Yang Su Jin and takes his wife suffering from dementia to the water's edge. After sharing their last words, he drives into the water. Meanwhile, Ho Chul receives a call confirming a DNA match from the sample he requested and the DNA found under Yang Su Jin's nails.

videos.title: Miss Lee Gets Arrested
videos.overview: Ho Chul interrogates Miss Lee for the murder of Yang Su Jin. However, even before she gets to tell the truth, footage of the hit-and-run driver falls into the police's hands. When the driver's face shows, Ho Chul can't believe his eyes and admits his relationship with Lee Myung Won. Meanwhile, Yang Su Jin's mother dies.
